observations:
Torah #34 contains 28 bechina edges yielding 5 packages after merges (7 raw connected components). A systematic search for independent new domains was conducted by scanning all bechina-language phrases in the source text not yet captured in the dataset.

Candidate cluster 1 — Speech/Mouth: דבור, כלי השפע, פה, מלא פום, מלאפום. These all orbit the theme of the tzaddik's full-mouth speech as divine vessel. However, this cluster does not form an independent domain — it is the core of Package 3 (מלאפום) and Package 1 (פה). דבור and כלי השפע are additions to existing packages, not independent components. Count of novel nodes with mutual bechina connections: only 2 (דבור ↔ כלי השפע, via 'הַדִּבּוּר הוּא כְּלֵי הַשֶּׁפַע'). Threshold for new package: 3+ concepts with bechina connections forming an independent domain. This cluster falls below threshold and attaches to Package 3.

Candidate cluster 2 — Kehunah/Holy Love: כהן, כהנה, אברהם, ברית שלום, אהבה קדושה. These are all identified in the source text with bechina language as expressions of holy love/chesed. However, they do not form an independent domain — they are extensions and amplifications of Package 4 (קדושת החסד). The source text explicitly links each of them to יסוד דאצילות (Package 4's anchor node): 'הַכְּהֻנָּה הִיא בְּחִינַת אַהֲבָה, הוּא אַבְרָהָם, שׁוֹרָה בִּמְקוֹם בְּרִית שָׁלוֹם, הַיְנוּ: צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם.' The chain explicitly connects kehunah → ahavah → Avraham → brit shalom → tzaddik yesod olam (Package 4). These are additions to Package 4, not an independent new package.

Candidate cluster 3 — Evil Broken-Vessel cluster: שברי לוחות, ערלת לב, אהבות רעות. These three concepts have bechina language in the source text and form a cluster around broken/fallen states. However, they are all equated with חרפה and ערלה (Package 5) using הַיְנוּ-chains: 'הַיְנוּ חֲרָפוֹת, הַיְנוּ עָרְלַת לֵב, הַיְנוּ אַהֲבוֹת רָעוֹת.' They extend Package 5 rather than forming a separate evil domain. שברי לוחות also enters as the evil mirror of Package 2's לוחות — not an independent new domain but a polarity reflection.

No cluster of 3 or more novel bechina-connected concepts was found that could not be assigned to one of the five existing packages. The five packages as defined cover the full conceptual architecture of Torah #34:
- Package 1: The point/yud/wisdom/tzaddik (positive pole of knowledge)
- Package 2: The vav/heart/Israel/binah (positive pole of reception)
- Package 3: Mela'fum/yud+vav integrated/Joseph the ruler (positive pole of abundance)
- Package 4: Holy chesed/yesod/ahavah preserved (positive pole of love)
- Package 5: Fallen love/shame/arlah (evil pole — broken chesed)

The Torah's good/evil mirror structure is complete: Package 4 (holy chesed) mirrors Package 5 (fallen chesed); Package 2 (holy luchot/lev) mirrors the שברי לוחות of Package 5. No additional structural domains require new packages.
